name: CoreAiChatHeader
intent: Header bar above an AI chat conversation — a title/usage line plus a right-side action cluster. Pass `sessionName` to render the conversation name in the left cluster; with `onSessionNameChange` it becomes click-to-edit (Enter or blur commits, Escape reverts) and re-seeds itself when the name changes underneath.
when: Show context/usage and actions above a CoreAiChat
